vfh_command_stone_desc: Left click a board's hireling to have it follow you. Left click a follower at home to post a guard on that spot (or send a worker back to work); in the field, to make it stay or follow. Left click a tree, rock or enemy to send your followers at it, or the ground to have them hold there. Right click a follower or posted guard to release it (at another of your boards, the follower joins that board); right click nothing to call everyone back. Shift+E on a hireling for orders. Followers: 1 at quality 1, up to 4 at quality 4.

vfh_say_generic_1: You just gonna stand there and watch?
vfh_say_generic_2: I was promised mead. Where's the mead?
vfh_say_generic_3: My back's not what it was in the Meadows.
vfh_say_generic_4: Odin's beard, this job doesn't pay enough.
vfh_say_generic_5: Somebody tell the boss I'm working. I'm definitely working.
vfh_say_generic_6: If I die out here, tell my mother I died bravely. Lie if you have to.
vfh_say_generic_7: Do you ever sleep, or just stand around giving orders?
vfh_say_generic_8: Back home I was a jarl, you know. Sort of.
vfh_say_generic_9: Is it lunch yet? Feels like lunch.
vfh_say_generic_10: I could do this with my eyes closed. Don't make me prove it.
vfh_say_generic_11: Nice armor. Did you make it yourself? It shows.
vfh_say_generic_12: Ten more minutes, then I'm taking a break. I've decided.
vfh_say_woodcutter_1: Timber! ...Sorry, did that one land near you?
vfh_say_woodcutter_2: Every tree I fell grows back. It's like they're mocking me.
vfh_say_woodcutter_3: The greydwarves get angry when I chop. I take it personally too.
vfh_say_woodcutter_5: I talk to the trees before I cut them. It doesn't help either of us.
vfh_say_woodcutter_6: Beech, birch, fir, pine... they all creak the same.
vfh_say_woodcutter_7: You know how many logs one roof takes? Too many.
vfh_say_woodcutter_8: Swing, chop, carry. Swing, chop, carry. Living the dream.
vfh_say_miner_1: Rocks don't talk back. That's why I like them.
vfh_say_miner_2: I've got dust in places dust shouldn't be.
vfh_say_miner_3: Copper again? Wake me when it's silver.
vfh_say_miner_4: One more swing and this whole rock is yours. Probably. Maybe ten.
vfh_say_miner_5: You want it mined, or mined nicely?
vfh_say_miner_6: My pickaxe has more personality than most vikings.
vfh_say_miner_7: If I dig too deep, at least it's warm down there.
vfh_say_miner_8: Stone, stone, stone. Oh look. More stone.
vfh_say_steward_1: Who let the fire go out? Was it you? It was you.
vfh_say_steward_2: I sweep, I stoke, I smelt. Nobody notices until I stop.
vfh_say_steward_3: The bees don't like me. The feeling is mutual.
vfh_say_steward_4: If one more person drops loot on my clean floor...
vfh_say_steward_5: Somebody has to keep this place running. Clearly it isn't you.
vfh_say_steward_6: The kiln's hungry again. The kiln is always hungry.
vfh_say_steward_7: I've sorted your chests. You'll undo it by tonight.
vfh_say_steward_8: Repairs, again? What do you do to these walls?
vfh_say_farmer_1: Carrots don't plant themselves. Well, I plant them.
vfh_say_farmer_2: Don't step on the rows. I see you eyeing the rows.
vfh_say_farmer_3: A good harvest is all about patience. And not being eaten by boars.
vfh_say_farmer_4: Rain would be nice. Not on me, on the crops.
vfh_say_farmer_5: You want turnips? I'll give you turnips.
vfh_say_farmer_6: I named that onion. Don't eat that onion.
vfh_say_farmer_7: Seeds in, food out. Simple. Unlike you.
vfh_say_farmer_8: Dirt under my nails is honest dirt.
vfh_say_cook_1: Taste this. No, not that one. That one's for the boar.
vfh_say_cook_2: If you don't like my stew, there's always raw meat.
vfh_say_cook_3: Who keeps eating straight out of the chests?
vfh_say_cook_4: Fire's hot, pot's hot, cook's annoyed.
vfh_say_cook_5: I could bake you bread if anyone ever brought me barley.
vfh_say_cook_6: A little more salt? We don't have salt. Pretend.
vfh_say_cook_7: My soup has saved more lives than your sword.
vfh_say_cook_8: Out of my kitchen unless you're carrying ingredients.
vfh_say_rancher_1: Don't name them. It only makes it harder.
vfh_say_rancher_2: That one with the stars? She stays. The rest, we'll see.
vfh_say_rancher_3: A boar eats more than you'd think. More than you, some days.
vfh_say_rancher_4: Two's a breeding pair. One's a lonely pig.
vfh_say_rancher_5: They don't know what the knife is for. Best keep it that way.
vfh_say_rancher_6: Mind where you step. Pens are pens.
vfh_say_rancher_7: Fed, watered, counted. Somebody has to.
vfh_say_rancher_8: You want meat, or you want pets? I can do both, just not with the same boar.
vfh_say_guard_1: Nothing gets past me. Except maybe that squirrel.
vfh_say_guard_2: I'm not scowling. This is my guarding face.
vfh_say_guard_3: Bring me something to hit. I'm getting bored.
vfh_say_guard_4: The trolls have heard of me, you know. They whisper.
vfh_say_guard_6: My shield has more dents than your excuses.
vfh_say_guard_7: Stand behind me. Further. Further. Good.
vfh_say_guard_8: I've seen greylings braver than you. Just saying.
vfh_say_archer_1: I never miss. That tree moved.
vfh_say_archer_2: Arrows don't grow on trees. Well, technically...
vfh_say_archer_3: You stand there, I'll shoot whatever eats you.
vfh_say_archer_4: Feathers, wood, flint. My whole life in a quiver.
vfh_say_archer_5: I can hit a neck at fifty paces. The animal, not yours.
vfh_say_archer_6: Close range is for people with shields. I have opinions.
vfh_say_archer_7: Watching the treeline. Always watching the treeline.
vfh_say_wizard_1: I didn't study magic for ten years to guard a woodpile.
vfh_say_wizard_2: Stand back. No, further. Magic is imprecise.
vfh_say_wizard_4: My robes are not a dress. They are vestments.
vfh_say_wizard_5: Eitr is not 'glowing juice'. Stop calling it that.
vfh_say_wizard_6: One day a spell will go off in my sleeve. Not today. Probably.
vfh_say_wizard_7: Greydwarves fear me. Or at least they burn well.
vfh_say_wizard_8: Swords are for people who can't read.
vfh_say_watching_1: You just gonna stand there and watch?
vfh_say_watching_2: Grab a tool or grab a seat. Pick one.
vfh_say_watching_3: Taking notes? I charge extra for lessons.
vfh_say_watching_6: Hovering doesn't make it go faster.
vfh_say_following_1: Where are we going? Do you even know?
vfh_say_following_2: Slow down! Some of us are carrying your stuff.
vfh_say_following_3: If this is a shortcut, I'd hate to see the long way.
vfh_say_following_5: We've passed that rock three times.
vfh_say_following_6: Adventure, they said. Fun, they said.
vfh_say_idle_1: Nothing to do. Don't tell anyone.
vfh_say_idle_2: I'm on break. A long, well-earned break.
vfh_say_idle_3: Got any work, or should I just look busy?
vfh_say_idle_4: I'd help, but you haven't given me anything to do.
vfh_say_idle_5: Standing around is a skill. I'm very skilled.
vfh_say_full_1: My pack's full. Want me to carry you too?
vfh_say_full_2: No more room. Unless you want me to eat it.
vfh_say_full_3: I'm not a pack mule. Fine, I'm a pack mule. A full one.
vfh_say_full_4: Full up! Where does all this go?
vfh_say_taunt_3: Is that all you've got? Come and get it!
vfh_say_fight_5: Ha! Felt that one, didn't you?
vfh_say_scared_3: I'm a worker, not a warrior!
vfh_say_wet_2: My boots are full of water. Again.
vfh_say_wet_3: Next contract, I'm asking for a roof.
vfh_say_wet_4: Rain, rain, go bother the trolls.
